f1.evidence: a smaller Jasper 10x3 model was trained with SGD with momentum for 400 epochs on a combined 80-hour WSJ dataset (LDC93S6A / WSJ0 and LDC94S13A / WSJ1)

f2.evidence: evaluated on the Hub5 Year 2000 (Hub5'00) evaluation (LDC2002S09, LDC2005S13), split into Switchboard (SWB) and Callhome (CHM) subsets

f3.evidence: acoustic and language models were trained on the 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard training data (LDC2004S13, LDC2005S13, LDC97S62)... Jasper DR 10x5 was trained with SGD with momentum for 50 epochs, compared against other models trained on the same data
